run_mpi_multiclip_optimizer: run the DeepMimic multiclip optimizer with MPI using a specified number of parallel workers
run_with_custom_workers: run the multiclip optimizer with a custom number of MPI worker processes via command line args
run_with_passthrough_args: run the multiclip optimizer and pass all additional command line arguments through to the optimizer script
review_main_entry_point: review the main entry point that parses num_workers and launches mpiexec with the DeepMimic optimizer
summarize_mpi_launch_script: summarize the MPI launch script that uses ArgParser and subprocess to spawn parallel DeepMimic optimization workers
